think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s documented type and valid range. 2) Check whether any specific numeric value(s) (e.g., -1, 0) are documented to switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (disable/enable a different algorithm/auto mode) rather than just “smaller/larger”. 3) If such value(s) exist, classify as a special knob and list the special value(s); otherwise classify as non-special.
